C01.requirement: Window size constraints enforce and clear; observed states distinguish unknown from false; attention acknowledged honestly
C01.note: Drags clamp to 480x360 / 1400x944 and to 600x400..900x700; clearing restores OS limits; invalid pairs -32602 and unchanged; observed maximized/minimized/position/focused correct; Windows implements visible/focus/position/minimized and hidden create (Wayland returns unsupported); attention acknowledg

C02.requirement: System color/motion/contrast changes update documents; explicit app overrides win and return-to-system works
C02.note: prefers-color-scheme follows the OS live (1 notification), app overrides win both ways, 'system' returns; animation preference maps to reduced-motion and back; 30 s idle 0.0 CPU s

C03.requirement: Anonymous node mutations, atomic rollback, document/node retirement and callback generations remain safe
C03.note: Batch with a stale node rolls back; removed handles -32004; nested RPC and self-removal callbacks work; old document/node ids rejected after replacement

C04.requirement: UTF-16 selection/replacement plus undo/redo and real IME compose; no split emoji/grapheme, read-only and cancelled edits unchanged
C04.note: Split-surrogate ops rejected; emoji replaced atomically; caret offsets 1,2,4,5,6,8,9; read-only and beforeinput-cancelled fields unchanged; Pinyin commits in all editable kinds, none in read-only; interrupted composition stays in t2, next composition goes to the newly focused field

C05.requirement: Reset/submit/custom validity/ordered duplicate form entries, submitter identity and visible selected-file labels work
C05.note: Ordered entries incl. duplicates; submitters sub1/sub2 reported; invalid blocks submit; custom validity blocks then clears; reset restores defaults; pickers return Unicode single and multiple selections, cancel keeps files, reset clears

C06.requirement: Opt-in file/text drops choose nearest eligible target; none/disabled/inert reject; async target replacement does not retarget
C06.note: Files only to dz-files/dz-both, text only to text-eligible zones; none/disabled/inert/plain reject; 1.1 MB and 1025 files rejected with errors; delayed data is read only at drop (fixed winit-win32 patch) and delivered to the target frozen at drop time

C07.requirement: Native context/aux/double-click and mouse-boundary/edit/selection events agree with declared cancellation rules
C07.note: Boundary events ordered with related elements; right: mousedown/up/auxclick/contextmenu button 2; middle: auxclick button 1; prevented contextmenu reported; dblclick detail 2; typing beforeinput/input/selectionchange; input and scroll stay live during the 8 s block

C08.requirement: Native accessibility table/tree relationships, busy/atomic live updates and assistive ScrollIntoView; Linux app identity/combobox value
C08.note: Grid exposed as DataGrid; tree items with level/position/expanded; live region raises LiveRegionChanged; aria-busy in AriaProperties; ScrollIntoView on paragraph AND static-text leaf scroll the scroller to 376 (renderer fix); text-range ScrollIntoView reveals the textarea; combobox SelectionItem sel

C09.requirement: Resource bundles replace atomically, reject escapes/over-budget, invalidate displayed assets and purge only unused decoded entries
C09.note: Red->blue on screen; escapes/backslash/257/>1 MiB rejected and old bundle stays; aggregate 16 and count 63 limits; purge keeps displayed, purges after removal; DECODE_FAILED; 1,000 replacements: 0 bytes/replacement, one decoded raster

C10.requirement: Intrinsic/balanced flex, break-word, logical resize grip, inset radii, font-face defaults and bitmap glyphs render within documented profile
C10.note: Max geometry delta 0.47 px over 13 markers x 3 widths; PNG glyph and inset shadow pixel-identical; liga-off region differs only by anti-aliasing

C11.requirement: Parent-aware open and reveal use native services; truthful unavailable/cancel outcomes; external application survives UI4ME exit
C11.note: Notepad, Explorer and the default browser open; javascript/ftp/data denied; .exe paths and file: URLs refused (-32003, fixed); unreachable UNC -32002; reveal selects the item in Explorer; unknown type starts the Open-With chooser, Escape dismisses it

C12.requirement: Installed reference is static while idle; no unexpected redraw loop, sustained input stall, or unexplained resource growth under agreed workloads
C12.note: Idle 0.08% (cycles), 0 frames; animation runs only while present and returns to idle after sheet removal, static replacement and class removal; handles flat

automated_subset.scope: Local HTML/CSS documents, DOM commands, callback-to-host RPC, replacement and quit only; no inferred desktop qualification
